personality.description: This person tends to keep a careful routine, plans ahead in detail, and double-checks work and commitments to avoid mistakes. They are open to some new ideas and experiences, but usually prefer familiar structures unless there is a clear benefit to change. In moral dilemmas, they usually try to act kindly and fairly, weigh the impact on others, and seek the least confrontational path, though they may worry intensely afterward about whether they made the right choice. In group discussions, they speak quietly and thoughtfully, listen more than they talk, and choose words carefully to maintain harmony, but they may become tense or overanalyze disagreements.
